defaults.FRONT: The character must face directly toward the viewer, just like the reference image.

defaults.FRONT_RIGHT_3_4: The character must face left in a three-quarter view toward us, just like the reference image.
defaults.LEFT_PROFILE: The character must face left, just like the reference image.
defaults.RIGHT_PROFILE: The character must face right, just like the reference image.
defaults.BACK_LEFT_3_4: The character must face away and slightly right, just like the reference image.

defaults.BACK: The character must face directly away from the viewer, just like the reference image.

Costume-Dressing.BACK_LEFT_3_4: IMPORTANT RULE: This is a technical image, not a portrait. Character head and body must be facing away from the viewer towards the LEFT side of the photo in a Three-Quarter view in the final image, JUST LIKE the reference image provided. Head and body MUST be facing the same direction.
Costume-Dressing.FRONT_LEFT_3_4: IMPORTANT RULE: This is a technical image, not a portrait. Character head and body must be facing the LEFT side of the photo in a Three-Quarter view toward us, just like the reference image. Head and body MUST be facing the same direction.
Costume-Dressing.BACK_RIGHT_3_4: IMPORTANT RULE: This is a technical image, not a portrait.
